title: Present Moral Duty vs. Unfulfilled Past Obligation

sections.title: Two Temporal Planes of Conscience
sections.content: In ethical deliberation, speakers constantly shift between what could NOT be changed in the past ('kellett volna' / 'nem szabadott volna') and what ought to be done right now ('kellene' / 'nem volna szabad'). Keeping these two forms distinct is critical in B2 Hungarian.

sections.title: Preverb Placement with Modals
sections.content: With both 'kellene' and 'kellett volna', when the infinitive has a separable preverb and no other element is focused, the preverb climbs in front of the modal: 'El kellett volna mondani az igazságot' (past hindsight) vs. 'El kellene mondani az igazságot' (present/future moral duty).

sections.title: Contrasting Moral Timeframes
rows: El kellett volna mondani az igazságot.
The truth should have been told. (Unfulfilled past)
The truth should be told now. (Present moral duty)
One should not have remained silent. (Past violation)
One ought not to remain silent now. (Present caution)

items.spanish: A múltban őszintébbnek kellett volna lennünk, most viszont szembe kell néznünk a következményekkel.
items.english: In the past we should have been more honest, whereas now we must face the consequences.

items.spanish: Nem szabadott volna eltitkolni a leletet, és most sem volna szabad halogatni a döntést.
items.english: The finding should not have been concealed, and the decision ought not to be delayed now either.

items.spanish: Tiszteletben kellett volna tartani a beteg önrendelkezési jogát.
items.english: The patient's right to self-determination should have been respected.

sections.title: B2 Stylistic Notice
sections.content: Notice the subtle shift: 'nem szabadna' or 'nem volna szabad' warns against a present/future mistake, while 'nem szabadott volna' judges a completed past act.
